brief.title: Discovery workshop — Teacher dashboard for state assessment programme — 18 Feb 2
business_goals: Teachers need a dashboard where they can see their own class's foundational literacy and numeracy scores after each assessment cycle, in the language they teach in.
The dashboard has to load in under 5 seconds on a 3G connection, or teachers just won't use it — we saw that with the last app we rolled out.
The dashboard needs to pull scanned assessment results from the existing OMR scanning system once they're processed — we're not changing how the scanning happens.

Teachers should be able to see which specific learning outcomes their students are struggling with — not just an overall score, but a breakdown by competency, like "cannot read a simple paragraph" versus "reading fluently."
constraints: Budget for this phase is fixed at 60 lakh rupees, already approved, and it has to be ready before the next assessment cycle starts in June — that date isn't moving, it's tied to the academic calendar.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
